# The Wanderbug

> > A travel blog by Genevieve Lauren documenting adventures across Australia, Europe, and beyond with destination guides, cultural experiences, and personal travel reflections.

The Wanderbug features destination guides and travel stories from Melbourne, Brisbane, Gold Coast, and Queensland in Australia, alongside European adventures through France, Italy, Greece, and Switzerland. The blog includes practical travel itineraries, food and culture guides, and personal Sunday Stories reflections on life as a traveler.

## Key Topics

- Melbourne travel and culture
- Brisbane and Queensland destinations
- Gold Coast beaches and hinterland
- European travel itineraries
- France and Paris guides
- Italy and Cinque Terre
- Greece destinations
- Australian coastal experiences
- New Caledonia cruise travel
- Travel reflections and Sunday Stories
- Food and dining guides
- Free cultural events
- Mornington Peninsula
- Great Ocean Road
- Switzerland mountain experiences

## Destination Hubs

- [Europe](https://thewanderbug.com/europe): Europe destination hub covering Greece and European travel itineraries
- [Switzerland](https://thewanderbug.com/switzerland): Switzerland destination hub featuring Zurich and Europe travel itineraries
- [Great Ocean Road](https://thewanderbug.com/great-ocean-road): Victoria's Great Ocean Road destination hub and coastal travel guide

## Australian Experiences

- [10 reasons I'm excited to live in Melbourne](https://thewanderbug.com/10-reasons-im-excited-to-live-in-melbourne/fashion): Melbourne's culture, arts, food scene and lifestyle for new residents
- [Brisbane Whale Watching in Moreton Bay](https://thewanderbug.com/brisbane-whale-watching/img_7412): Humpback whale watching day trip from Brisbane's Redcliffe Jetty
- [Free in Melbourne: Ballet in the Bowl](https://thewanderbug.com/ballet-in-the-bowl-melbourne/img_5717): Australian Ballet & Orchestra Victoria perform Swan Lake at outdoor event
- [Where to eat & drink on Mt Tamborine, Gold Coast](https://thewanderbug.com/eating-my-way-around-mt-tamborine/img_7774): Restaurant, cafe, brewery & winery guide for Mt Tamborine hinterland

## European Adventures

- [Monterosso: The best beach in Cinque Terre](https://thewanderbug.com/monterosso-cinque-terre/p1050533): Beach guide to Monterosso al Mare's private beaches on Italian Riviera
- [Daytrip from Paris: The Champagne Region](https://thewanderbug.com/driving-through-champagne/img_3600): Champagne vineyard tour through Reims, Epernay & Ay from Paris
- [Floating up Mt Pilatus, Luzern](https://thewanderbug.com/floating-up-mt-pilatus-luzern/dscn1598): Gondola ride to Mt Pilatus summit in Luzern, Switzerland
- [Finding the Parc des Rocher Doms in Avignon](https://thewanderbug.com/parc-des-rocher-doms-avignon/dscn3245): Escape summer heat at Avignon's hilltop park near Palace des Papes
- [The changing faces of the Champs-Elysee](https://thewanderbug.com/the-changing-landscape-of-the-champs-elysee/img_3455): Observations on luxury retail evolution along Paris's Champs-Élysées
- [Ladurée saves the day](https://thewanderbug.com/laduree-saves-the-day/img_3462): Parisian macaron experience at Ladurée in St Germain neighborhood
- [Eating in Italy: Breakfast](https://thewanderbug.com/eating-in-italy-breakfast/20130912-105104-jpg): Italian breakfast culture and pastries from Levanto to Florence

## New Caledonia & Pacific Islands

- [Postcards from Luecila Beach, Lifou](https://thewanderbug.com/luecila-beach-lifou/dsc_0418): New Caledonia cruise stop at Lifou's Luecila Beach with local culture
- [Switching off for a sunset in Noumea](https://thewanderbug.com/baie-des-citrons-noumea/dsc_0273): Digital detox sunset at Baie des Citrons beach in New Caledonia
